verdict.rationale: Unity's own blog says the Runtime (per-install) Fee was canceled, which supports the 'no per-install fees' part of the story. The license is not permissive, though: the free Personal plan is limited to organizations under $100K in revenue and funds raised, and community reports describe costly per-seat licensing and Unity unilaterally moving studios to pricier tiers. Missing for 10: a permissive or open license, documented confirmation of no royalties at any revenue level, free use above the $100K threshold, and assurance that terms won't change unilaterally.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the license is permissive with no royalties or per-install fees — I keep what my game earns

citations.quote: Unity is Canceling the Runtime Fee
Unity’s free plan, Unity Personal, is for individuals and small organizations with less than $100K of revenue and funds raised in the last 12 months.
